summary: Neurogene Inc. filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (424B5) for a public offering of common stock and pre-funded warrants. The filing is an ordinary capital raise, not a special situation. The offering is an underwritten follow-on, with terms (price, size, discounts) to be determined. Shares trade on Nasdaq under NGNE; last sale was $32.28. The proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes. No special-situation triggers such as acquisition, tender, restructuring, or activism are present.
